# AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/generators/gen_ai_probe.py. Do not edit manually.
# TEMPORARY (2026-11-15): the AI telemetry probe. Inert in a played game; it arms itself in a game with no
# human player, or from the console with `event te_debug_ai_probe.1` (`.2` disarms). What it logs and why:
# the generator's docstring and docs/testing/ai-probe-runbook.md. Remove with the generator.

# One more of a counter the country keeps between two snapshots. The set comes first: change_variable on a
# variable nobody set fails with an error and counts nothing (#1818).
te_aip_count = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_aip_n_$N$ } }
		set_variable = { name = te_aip_n_$N$ value = 0 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = te_aip_n_$N$ add = 1 }
}

# Arms the probe: the latch, the month count, the canaries. Called from the global monthly pulse in a game
# with no human player, and from `event te_debug_ai_probe.1`.
te_aip_arm = {
	set_global_variable = te_aip_on
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_aip_off }
		remove_global_variable = te_aip_off
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_aip_k } }
		set_global_variable = { name = te_aip_k value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = te_aip_next_id value = 0 }
	}
	debug_log = "TE_AIP ARM v=6"
	ordered_country = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_country_type = decentralized } }
		order_by = gdp
		position = 0
		te_aip_canary = yes
	}
}

te_aip_disarm = {
	remove_global_variable = te_aip_on
	set_global_variable = te_aip_off
	debug_log = "TE_AIP DISARM"
}

# The global month: arm in a game nobody plays, then count the month and stamp it with the date.
te_aip_global_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_aip_on }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_aip_off }
			NOT = { any_country = { is_player = yes } }
		}
		te_aip_arm = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_aip_on }
		change_global_variable = { name = te_aip_k add = 1 }
		random_country = {
			debug_log = "TE_AIP K [THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_k')|0] y=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_year')|0]"
			debug_log = "TE_AIP KDATE [THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_k')|0] [TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
			if = {
				limit = { te_aip_k_phase = 1 }
				debug_log = "TE_AIP W [THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_k')|0] y=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_year')|0] countries=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_w_countries')|0] dn=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_w_dn')|0] dn_states=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_w_dn_states')|0] states=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_w_states')|0] c_states=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_w_c_states')|0] r_fmc=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_w_r_fmc')|0] r_small=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_w_r_small')|0] r_bank=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_w_r_bank')|0]"
			}
		}
	}
}

# A serial for the country in scope, the first time the probe sees it: at its first monthly pulse, or at an
# event before that (version 1 logged such events, and every play, with id 0).
te_aip_ensure_id = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_aip_id } }
		change_global_variable = { name = te_aip_next_id add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_aip_id value = global_var:te_aip_next_id }
	}
}

# A country's pulse (every 30 days, not each calendar month: scripting_best_practices.md,
# `on_monthly_pulse_country` Is a 30-Day Timer): a serial on first sight, the month it is first due (this
# year's reporting month, or next year's once that has passed), then a snapshot at the first pulse in the due
# month or after it, which sets the next due month a calendar year on. So a country reports once in each
# calendar year, in its month (a February one in March when its pulse misses February). A second pulse in a
# 31-day month finds the next report a year off. Versions 1 and 2 counted twelve pulses instead (te_aip_m,
# now unused), 360 days, so a report drifted five days earlier a year.
te_aip_country_tick = {
	te_aip_ensure_id = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_aip_due } }
		set_variable = { name = te_aip_due value = te_aip_first_due }
		if = {
			limit = { te_aip_due_in < 0 }
			change_variable = { name = te_aip_due add = 12 }
		}
	}
	# The cycle's phase triggers read finance_cycle_value unguarded, so they run only once the cycle runs.
	if = {
		limit = { te_banking_cycle_running = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { banking_cycle_is_recession = yes }
			te_aip_count = { N = bank_down }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_aip_due_in <= 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_aip_due value = te_aip_next_due }
		te_aip_snapshot = yes
	}
}

# A law's enactment as it starts, passes or fails: the law by its index (ai_probe_key.json, all_laws).
te_aip_law_event = {
	te_aip_ensure_id = yes
	te_aip_count = { N = law_$WHAT$ }
	debug_log = "TE_AIP E law_$WHAT$ [THIS.GetCountry.GetTagName] [THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_id')|0] [THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_k')|0] law=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_law_enacting')|0] chance=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_ev_enact_chance')|2] stall=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_ev_stall_chance')|2] setbacks=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_ev_setbacks')|0]"
}

# An enactment's end, with how it ended (ai_probe_key.json, law_end_how) and the setbacks it could take. The
# pass and fail hooks mark it just before (te_aip_law_how); the pass's mark stays for on_law_activated, which
# follows the end (vanilla's 00_code_on_actions.txt), so that activation is not counted as a law set by
# script (te_aip_law_activated). Any other mark is spent here.
te_aip_law_end_event = {
	te_aip_ensure_id = yes
	te_aip_count = { N = law_end }
	debug_log = "TE_AIP E law_end [THIS.GetCountry.GetTagName] [THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_id')|0] [THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_k')|0] law=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_law_enacting')|0] chance=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_ev_enact_chance')|2] stall=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_ev_stall_chance')|2] setbacks=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_ev_setbacks')|0] how=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_ev_law_how')|0] max=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_ev_max_setbacks')|0]"
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_aip_law_how
			NOT = { var:te_aip_law_how = 1 }
		}
		remove_variable = te_aip_law_how
	}
}

te_aip_default_event = {
	te_aip_ensure_id = yes
	debug_log = "TE_AIP E $WHAT$ [THIS.GetCountry.GetTagName] [THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_id')|0] [THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_k')|0] debt=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_debt_scaled')|3] gold=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_gold')|0] net_fixed=[THIS.ScriptValue('te_aip_net_fixed')|0]"
}

# A finished building, counted for its owner under the first class its group falls in.
te_aip_built_event = {
	save_scope_as = te_aip_building
	owner ?= {
		te_aip_count = { N = $WHAT$ }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:te_aip_building = { is_building_group = bg_government } }
			te_aip_count = { N = built_gov }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:te_aip_building = { is_building_group = bg_military } }
			te_aip_count = { N = built_mil }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:te_aip_building = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_infrastructure is_building_group = bg_private_infrastructure } } }
			te_aip_count = { N = built_infra }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:te_aip_building = { is_building_group = bg_power } }
			te_aip_count = { N = built_power }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:te_aip_building = { is_building_group = bg_manufacturing } }
			te_aip_count = { N = built_ind }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:te_aip_building = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_mining is_building_group = bg_logging is_building_group = bg_fishing is_building_group = bg_whaling is_building_group = bg_oil_extraction is_building_group = bg_rubber } } }
			te_aip_count = { N = built_res }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:te_aip_building = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_agriculture is_building_group = bg_plantations is_building_group = bg_ranching } } }
			te_aip_count = { N = built_agri }
		}
	}
}
